row.title: Cloudflare alerts reach the tick: cloudflare-alerts closed
row.body: The webhook destination for /hook/cloudflare passed Cloudflare's delivery test on 2026-11-22 (after a 30 s wait for the new CF_ALERT_SECRET to take effect; the first attempt got 503). Policies: incident_alert, workers_observability_alert (status FIRING_FAILED, the API refuses an empty filter), billing_budget_alert at 10 USD (billing_usage_alert needs a product and limit), universal_ssl_event_type. POLICIES in cfalerts.js now match what the account accepted.
